entry_condition: An agent or human chooses to use DoctorCode for diagnosis or repair evidence.
failure_behavior: Stale finding IDs, analyzer drift, blocking regressions, or ambiguous evidence stop the DoctorCode verification path instead of being guessed around.
invariants: The skill never creates findings independently of the CLI.
The verification contract is captured before repair.
Zero conservative references never prove safe deletion.
Repository-provided commands are not DoctorCode verification authority.
DoctorCode verification PASS is narrower than runtime correctness.
purpose: Sequence one deterministic DoctorCode finding through bounded context, pre-repair contract capture, minimal repair, and deterministic verification without duplicating core logic.
restart_behavior: Re-audit current source, select the current finding, and capture a fresh contract before a new repair attempt.
rollback_behavior: Removing the skill returns DoctorCode to direct CLI usage without changing core behavior.
title: Agent-guided DoctorCode repair lifecycle

transitions.action: Select one exact current deterministic finding.
Request a bounded context packet for the exact finding ID.
Capture the verification contract before source mutation.
Apply the smallest evidence-supported source repair under project authority.
side_effects: source mutation is performed by the human or agent, not DoctorCode

transitions.action: Run DoctorCode verify against the frozen contract.
Report DoctorCode evidence separately from project-specific runtime or test evidence.
